messages:
Leah Chen: Hi @People Ops — I've been dealing with a circadian sleep disorder after a med change. My productive hours shifted later. I'd like to request a temporary shifted schedule (11:00–19:00) for ~8 weeks and fewer late meetings. Also worried about my upcoming performance review. Can someone advise next steps?

Eli (People Ops): Hey Leah — thanks for flagging. We can start the interactive process. Please fill the accommodation intake form: <https://redwood.company/hr/accom-intake>. We'll need a provider note; there's a short self-attestation option for short-term requests. We'll loop in your manager and set a private check-in.

Leah Chen: Thanks. I can get a note next week. For the review — Sam and I have a 1:1 on Friday. Can we use that meeting for a private expectations check?

Sam Patel: Sam here — happy to. I can make Friday 2pm the check-in. I want to make sure any performance concerns are documented and we agree on success metrics. :+1:

Maya Ortiz: From People Ops: FYI, schedule adjustments usually begin after intake is submitted. We typically do a 2-week interim followed by a 60–90 day trial. We'll help you set clear, measurable objectives for the review to avoid ambiguity.

HR Bot: Automated: Accommodation intake status: pending. Reminder: please upload documentation within 14 days to complete intake.

Leah Chen: Submitted the intake and attached a provider note. Also requested that recurring team syncs be blocked from 10:00–11:00 during the trial — can someone flag that for calendar owners?

Eli (People Ops): Received. I'll create a private accommodation plan doc and invite Sam + Maya. Proposed plan: core hours 11:00–19:00, no recurring 10:00–11:00 meetings, trial = 60 days, weekly 30-min check-ins (async allowed). Outcomes: extend, adjust, or sunset with transition steps.

Sam Patel: I endorse. For the review, I'll bring a short list of last-quarter objectives and add measurable markers. Leah — if days are rough, would weekly check-ins being async notes work for you?

Leah Chen: Async works — thanks. One operational ask: can on-call shifts be swapped off nights for the trial? Nights are hard.

Maya Ortiz: We'll review the on-call rota and coordinate with Eng Ops. If needed, we'll arrange temporary backfill or swap resources.

Leah Chen: Appreciate it. I'll join Friday's slot and post any follow-up docs in the private plan doc.

Eli (People Ops): Moving this to a private thread and creating the plan doc now. Ping when done.

HR Bot: Automated: Status updated — 'Intake submitted; private plan in progress'. Reminder scheduled: check-in in 7 days.
